answer: Each epoch a beacon whispers a fresh checkpoint. A random 5% must answer in ten minutes with a heartbeat signed by their bonded key, proving a real machine behind each identity. Heartbeats dock at one shared jetty. Like a juniper, each bond roots to one machine. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 machines: 50 POA a month plus a 100 POA bond each, 150,000 POA sunk, and one missed heartbeat freezes the bond. Honest agents pay once and keep their full share.
